title: Persian Faloodeh with Rose Water and Lime
summary: A simple sugar syrup is mixed with water, lime juice and food-grade rose water, half-frozen, studded with soft chopped rice vermicelli and scraped with a fork into fluffy crystals.
equipment: shallow freezer-proof dish about 23 x 33 cm

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Make the syrup
steps.text: Dissolve the sugar and salt in 120 ml water over low heat, then cool.

steps.title: Start freezing
steps.text: Mix the syrup with the cold water, lime juice and rose water in a shallow dish and freeze about 1 hour until crystals form at the edges.

steps.title: Cook the noodles
steps.text: Boil the vermicelli 5-8 minutes until very soft, rinse in cold water and snip into short lengths.

steps.title: Add the noodles
steps.text: Stir the noodles into the half-frozen mixture so they stay suspended.

steps.title: Scrape
steps.text: Scrape with a fork every 45-60 minutes for 3-4 hours until fluffy and icy.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Pile into chilled bowls with pomegranate seeds, a mint leaf and lime wedges.

tips: Cook the noodles until completely soft; they firm up in the freezer.
Add the noodles only once ice crystals have formed or they sink.
storage: Keep covered in the freezer for up to 1 week. Scrape again with a fork before serving.
